description: Write or update a continuity document in the document store (versioned, prior copy archived to documents_history and marked obsolete, sha256 read-back verified). RECORDS - the handoff (HANDOFF.md) and any id in EMET_RECORD_DOCS - are superseded, never amended: patch_doc is refused on them, and a new revision is written here WHOLE with `supersedes` set to the version currently in force (ISO 9001 7.5.3 / 13485 4.2.5).

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

reason.description: Required on a record revision (at least 10 characters). Stored as edit_reason.

session_id.description: Transcript session id. The floor is measured from the size when this session first touched the document.

source.description: Source tag - which host produced this write. One name on every write since 2026-09-27.

supersedes.description: Required when writing a new revision of a RECORD (the handoff): the version currently in force, which this revision supersedes. Ignored for ordinary documents.

updated_by.description: Alias of `source` (the older name, kept one release). Prefer `source`.

name: write_doc
